## Summary

Describe the change, motivation and linked issue or plan item.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Scope and Contracts

- Public API/schema/CLI/config/file format changes:
- Backward compatibility or migration impact:
- Out-of-scope items:

## Validation Evidence

List exact commands, artifacts or manual checks.

```text
command -> result
```

## Skipped Checks and Residual Risk

List checks that were not run and why.

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
- [ ] `PROJECT_PLAN.md` and relevant `plans/modules/<module>.md` files are updated when scope, contracts or acceptance criteria changed
- [ ] Final handoff includes validation evidence, skipped checks, residual risks and an acceptance verdict
